name: RoboScience
summary: RoboScience is an embodied robotics developer established in 2024. It develops its Visics embodied model, the RoboMirage simulation engine and its own mobile manipulation hardware. The company works on robot operation across retail, logistics, industrial and household settings. Its published corporate brochure lists research and production locations in Beijing, Shenzhen, Suzhou and Hangzhou, while its World Robot Conference exhibitor identifies the Beijing legal entity.
